audience: Adult learners; adjust episode audience explicitly in CONFIG.
boundary: Attributed sacred narrative; distinguish text, tradition, commentary and historical evidence.
production_handoff: Provide cited narration, timed scene directions, continuity references and generation prompts for the user's external AI video workflow. No audiovisual generation pilot is required.

topics.title: Narrator and source attribution
topics.coverage: Text identity, speaker attribution and passage boundaries.
topics.exclusions: Treating a popular retelling as an unidentified primary text.
topics.evidence_required: Accessible edition, verse locator and named translator.
topics.next_action: Obtain and inspect identified textual sources before promoting these ideas.

topics.title: Narrative framing and chronology
topics.coverage: Summary, embedded narration and story order.
topics.exclusions: Converting narrative chronology into historical dating.
topics.evidence_required: Explicit textual sequence in one identified edition.
topics.next_action: Obtain and inspect identified textual sources before promoting these ideas.

topics.title: Translation and interpretive context
topics.coverage: Attributed wording choices within a bounded dialogue.
topics.exclusions: One interpretation presented as all communities' belief.
topics.evidence_required: Two named translations, surrounding verses and permissions.
topics.next_action: Obtain and inspect identified textual sources before promoting these ideas.

topics.title: Ramayana retellings
topics.coverage: A single episode in two specifically identified tellings.
topics.evidence_required: Two editions with separate provenance and commentary.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Mahabharata narrative dilemmas
topics.coverage: One decision, its dialogue and consequences within a named telling.
topics.exclusions: Modern moral slogans substituted for the textual argument.
topics.evidence_required: Passages before and after the selected decision.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Puranic story families
topics.coverage: One attributed narrative across a bounded text family.
topics.exclusions: Assuming uniform chronology or agreement among texts.
topics.evidence_required: Named text, edition, section and transmission context.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Regional performance and oral telling
topics.coverage: A named community, performance and storyteller context.
topics.exclusions: Inventing an oral tradition or using unlicensed recordings.
topics.evidence_required: Attributed recordings or field scholarship and consent.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Contested interpretation
topics.coverage: Document the positions and scope of one interpretive disagreement.
topics.exclusions: Declaring theological truth or fabricating consensus.
topics.evidence_required: Attributed positions with contextual and specialist review.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

series.title: Reading sacred narrative with attribution
series.entry_requirement: No prior episode required; explain specialist terms on first use.
series.learning_outcome: Identify a source and narrator before comparing structure or translation.
series.ordering_reason: Attribution precedes narrative analysis and comparison across translations.
